title: Hershey Kay, Milk and Honey and paying off debt
summary: Musicals put his kids through college and paid off Sauter-Finegan debt.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Hershey Kaye got me involved in it and the first one turned out to be a hit, Milk and Honey, and he showed me how to do it. So it got the kids through college and it's more or less supplied us with this home, although we still don't own it, it will be couple more years.
You're pretty close though; that's good.
You're lucky you got it when you did.
You're not kidding. That's the first time--it also help me pay off the Sauter-Finegan debt. The first couple of years of musicals I didn't retain any of it.
Before that time we couldn't own a house (inaudible). Don't send your kids to Harvard, they can go to NYU, which is fine with me.
